intro.text: A name Tress gives as one of her family lost on the Oot's Dream, probably someone she invented.

items.text: Tress listed Mallory with Kaplan and Marple when she lied to Crow about having kin aboard the Oot's Dream, so that Crow would want her to tell the world the Crow's Song had left no survivors. Crow gave her the chance to run at Shimmerbay, but Tress chose to stay.
